Frequently Asked Questions

What is the Crudo Protocol and how does it revolutionize the commodities market?
The Crudo Protocol is a platform leveraging blockchain technology to transform the acquisition and trading of commodities, focusing on crude oil. It aims to offer a transparent, secure, and efficient experience for investing in crude oil by eliminating traditional complexities
What are the benefits of using CRUDO for payments at partner gas stations, and how do users earn rewards through this process?
Users benefit from using CRUDO for payments at partner gas stations by earning rewards in CRUDO tokens that can be reused within the ecosystem or exchanged for FIAT.
How can token holders generate passive income by staking Crudo tokens?
Token holders can generate passive income by staking Crudo tokens, allowing them to earn rewards through this process. Staking will be introduced once CRUDO is listed on exchanges.
How does CRUDO protocol work?
Crudo Protocol provides a platform and an ecosystem to make real life investment in a trillion dollar industry easier for people. Users of the Crudo ecosystem can get access to a variety of tools necessary in the Oil and Gas industry all in one place.
What is the utility of the CRUDO token?
Crudo token is the native token of CRUDO protocol that will be listed on DEX and CEX and its utility is fundamental for the development of the project as all the transactions within the ecosystem are exclusively made in CRUDO tokens. Users can also pay at the petrol stations using Crudo tokens gaining access to cashback and discounts. Read our whitepaper to know more.
presale questions
What payment methods are accepted for purchasing CRUDO tokens?
The platform currently accepts payments in ETH, BNB and other cryptocurrencies. Check the How to buy section of our website.
Are there any bonuses for purchasing CRUDO tokens during presale?
Yes, there is a bonus for early investors. Get in touch with our team to find out if you are eligible for the bonus.
When do I receive my tokens?
The tokens sold during the presale stages are protected via vesting contract. Investors will receive 10% of their tokens in Stage 5 and another 10% at Stage 10 before we launch on DEX. The rest of the tokens are going to be airdropped on a monthly basis. Check the whitepaper for the token distribution release.
How long is the presale?
The presale is structured into 10 rounds with the price of the tokens set to increase after every single round sells out.
Are my tokens vested?
Yes, the tokens are vested. Check the dedicated section of the whitepaper to know more.
Is there any tax added to the token?
No buy or sell tax is applicable to your tokens.
Can I receive my tokens in my CEX wallet?
No, CRUDO tokens must be received in a DeFi wallet to ensure compatibility with the token's architecture. Once CRUDO will be listed on a centralised exchange you’ll be able to hold your tokens there.
What is the maximum amount I can purchase?
To protect our investors we have set a minimum personal cap of 0.1 BNB and a maximum personal cap of 100 BNBs worth of tokens bought during presale.
What network is Crudo Protocol deployed on?
The CRUDO token is deployed on the Binance Smart Chain.
